//: Type-checking for the dashboard JS. checkJs is TRUE: the whole dashboard/js directory is type-checked and any NEW .js file is covered automatically (the per-file `// @ts-check` comments are harmless no-ops). Full `strict` is ON — that subsumes noImplicitAny + strictNullChecks plus strictFunctionTypes, useUnknownInCatchVariables (catch vars are `unknown`: narrow with `err instanceof Error ? err.message : ...`), noImplicitThis, etc. Every param/var needs a determinable type and every possibly-null/undefined access must be guarded or narrowed — annotate with JSDoc (`/** @type {...} */ (expr)` casts, `?? fallback`, `x?.y`). tsc emits nothing; this is a checker only. Run via `npm run typecheck`.
